name: Can drywall repairs be included as part of storm or water restoration work?

mainEntity.name: Can drywall repairs be included as part of storm or water restoration work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Extensive drywall damage often stems from interior water leaks, burst pipes, or roof failure following severe Colorado hail and wind storms. In restoration situations, HH Remodeling works with property owners during storm-damage repairs to handle water mitigation tear-out, structural framing repairs, sheetrock reinstallation, and finish painting. Having a single contractor manage structural carpentry alongside drywall and paint simplifies documentation and ensures consistent quality from the studs out to the surface.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. We handle structural framing repair, drywall replacement, texturing, and interior painting as an integrated service for storm and water damage recovery.
